# About the Journal

The Journal of Cutaneous Oncology (JoCO) is an open-access journal whose scope is specific to skin cancer. JoCO publishes **Perspectives on the Science**, a regular commentary series based on publications reviewed in the multi-institutional SoCO Journal Club.

These perspectives are intended to interpret emerging data, highlight clinical and scientific context, and support thoughtful discussion across the cutaneous oncology community. The comments in each article represent the views of the authors of that Perspectives on the Science piece and do not necessarily represent the views of other SoCO members or affiliated institutions.
